- **Lane:** `AGENTS.md` and `docs/adr/**` are the governed surface, so `domain:skills` takes it. The whole diff is judged at Tier H, including the ratchet test and the PR template: a draft PR, the maintainer's quick-read, and no queue before an authorised approval.
- **The ratchet is the maintainer's direction**, so the new-gate default (no) does not apply here.
- **The baseline** is read at the PR's own head. In-flight work under the frozen paths (objectstack-ai/objectui#12190 in `app-shell/src/environment/`) lands first and enters the baseline, or rebases under the ratchet. ⛔ It is not waved through after.
- The ADR number is re-read at claim. 0060 was the next free number when the card was filed.

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — the default judgment tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the rider path at `9f4b652e3a` printed 「Model tier — no path-derived mandate」 (floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable); the objectui paths are outside that tool's repo and outside the protocol-semantic surface, and the ratchet's design carries judgment, so the default tier, not the floor
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card` (a maintainer-directed governance card)
Thread-read: 6123756892
Ruling-ref: the maintainer's chat ruling quoted verbatim in the card body (「现在转向」; 「规则应该写入 objectui 仓库，要不然每个项目都会有页面定制的需求」), and triage's grade 6123756892 (the ratchet is the maintainer's direction; the whole diff is Tier H; the baseline is read at the PR's own head).
Resume-from: none
Serial constraints cleared: objectui open PRs — 8, with 156 changed files read: none touches `AGENTS.md`, `docs/adr/**`, a PR template, `app-shell/src/environment/`, `console/organizations/`, `console/home/Cloud*` or `i18n/src/locales/`. objectui in-flight claims — 8 `pm:dispatched` cards read; one hit, objectui#7611 (epic `#15194`, `marchtian`), which declares locale entries in `packages/i18n/src/locales/`. That is text-disjoint, because this card edits no locale file. The coupling is semantic: the ratchet's baseline is read at this PR's head, so what #7611 lands first enters the baseline, and what lands after must pass the ratchet, with no wave-through (triage 6123756892). objectui#12190 is closed. objectstack — no open PR touches `filing-gate.md`.
Delivery shape: objectui PR `Fixes #12224`, Tier H (draft until an authorized approval). The objectstack rider PR names `objectstack-ai/objectui#12224` with no closing keyword; it is Tier S (`.claude/**`).

The at-tier contract review `6134399082` reads PASS on this head. The seat holds the ACCEPT for one item that review raised (its item 5). ADR-0060's "Consequences" bullet says every pull request's description carries the template's checkbox. That is false: GitHub prefills the template only for PRs opened in the web form, and every fleet PR, this one included, is opened through the API. Nothing enforces the checkbox. A governed record must not state a guarantee nothing delivers.

Patch round sent to the same dev on the same claim: narrow that bullet, and line 71's mention if it overclaims the same way. Nothing else in the PR changes. The review's other items are design calls for the maintainer: the H3 locale reading, the freeze scope beyond the card, the ceiling living in the governed ADR, the `organizations`/`workspace` vs `organization`/`chatbotQuota` split, and the two product words.
